title: Kura agent registry
description: The standalone agent registry for the catalog at ~/.config/kura/catalog. An agent exists for Kura only when this file names it, and its source is agents/<name>.md. Unregistered files are ignored. Registered but absent sources remain representable for `kura list` and `kura doctor`. Bundle-owned agents are covered by their bundle registration, not this registry.

$schema.description: URL or relative path of this schema.

version.description: Informational registry format version. Kura ignores it and does not negotiate compatibility.

upstream.description: Upstream repositories, keyed by GitHub owner/repo. This records agent origin; `kura update` and `kura outdated` act only on skills.

local.description: Standalone agents authored in the catalog itself, without an upstream.

branch.description: Upstream ref recorded as metadata. Kura does not fetch standalone agents.

upstream_path.description: Agent path in the upstream repository. Its last component, or the repository name when empty, omitted, "." or "/", names the agent unless `name` overrides it. A Markdown file path needs an explicit extensionless `name`.

name.description: Overrides the name derived from `upstream_path`, without the source file's .md extension.

agentName.description: One safe path component, used as agents/<name>.md. It must equal the source file stem and the frontmatter `name`; an agent also needs a non-empty frontmatter `description`.

skillName.description: One safe path component naming a registered root skill, not an agent or a bundle-owned skill.

groups.description: Descriptive tags, matched exactly and never normalised. The retired `global` tag is refused; use the boolean field instead.

dependencies.description: Registered root skill names required recursively by this agent. Global agents include these skills in the global closure. Dependencies are never written to a project's kura.json.

globalPolicy.description: Whether this standalone agent is a durable global root. Bare `kura sync` links it and its recursive skill dependencies into every globally enabled harness. Pi needs a configured global agent path; `sync --type skill` leaves agent views unchanged.

dependencyOnly.description: Dependency-only metadata accepted for standalone agents. Kura currently enforces direct-add refusal only for skills.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp recorded in the registry. Kura does not update standalone agent content.
